chapter_seo_title: Han Li’s Rescue Trap: Illusion Formation Buy-Time Escape
chapter_meta_description: Han Li risks everything to snatch Nan Gong Wan from Wang Chan’s grasp, then springs an Illusion Formation trap to buy escape time. Dong Xuan’er hesitates. A classic Mortal Stream rescue.
og_description: Han Li risks everything to rescue Nan Gong Wan, springing an Illusion Formation trap on Wang Chan and the flamboyant man.
twitter_title: Han Li’s rescue backfires into an illusion trap
twitter_description: Han Li risks everything to save Nan Gong Wan, springing an Illusion Formation on the demonic duo.

lore_anchors.definition: The condensed spiritual essence of a high-level cultivator, capable of independent existence and possession. In *RMJI*, it represents a second life that can flee or fight even after the body is destroyed.
A type of defensive array that confuses the senses, misdirects movement, and traps enemies by distorting their perception of reality; it is a delaying tactic rather than a direct attack.
The cultivation stage after Foundation Establishment, where a cultivator condenses a Golden Core (金丹) inside their body, granting significantly increased lifespan and magical power.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li risk himself for Nan Gong Wan?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He explicitly acknowledges that he is not truly heartless; he acts not for calculated profit but because he cannot abandon someone he shares a deep bond with. It is a rare and contained emotional override to his usual pragmatism.
She recognizes Han Li and hesitates, caught between her new allegiance to the Blissful Union Sect and her lingering history with him. In the Mortal Stream, such a hesitation is a costly luxury.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did Han Li set up the formation in time?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He noticed the battle’s trajectory earlier and silently prepared the Illusion Formation while observing from below. It is a textbook display of his combat doctrine: always layer your exits before you engage.
